statusRequest._incomingComment: A change the AGENT proposed — ours to approve or reject.

pause.label: Wants to pause

incoming.fallbackDescription: A contract change awaiting your decision.

statusRequest._outgoingComment: A change WE proposed — ours to cancel, theirs to answer.

pause.label: Pause proposed
pause.description: Waiting on the agent to agree. Until they do, nothing about the contract changes.

reactivate.label: Resume proposed
reactivate.description: Waiting on the agent to agree. Until they do, nothing about the contract changes.

deactivate.label: Removal proposed
deactivate.description: Waiting on the agent to agree. The contract ends only once they do and any cash and unpaid earnings are settled.

outgoing.fallbackDescription: A contract change you proposed, waiting on the agent.

blocked.title: Settle up before approving
blocked.outstandingCod: They still hold {{amount}} of your COD cash.
blocked.outstandingPayment: You still owe them {{amount}} in earnings.
blocked.recheckMine: Re-checked when the agent agrees — until it clears, their approval would be refused.
blocked.recheckTheirs: Checked again when you approve — approving now would be refused.

termsProposal.mineDescription: Waiting on the agent. Your agreed terms stay in force until they accept — nothing has changed yet.
termsProposal.theirsDescription: The terms below are what they are asking for. Your current terms stay in force until you accept — nothing has changed yet.
termsProposal.noChange: This proposal restates the current terms — nothing would actually change.
termsProposal.notePlaceholder: Add a note for the agent (optional)…

offerDialog.title: Offer {{name}} a contract
offerDialog.description: They can accept these terms, decline, or come back with their own. Nothing starts until they accept.
offerDialog.feeSplitRequired: A fee split is required — it is what pays the agent.

membership.srDescription: Contract details for {{name}} — COD limit, negotiated terms, settlements and history.

ending.rejected: The agent turned down your request
ending.withdrawn: The request was withdrawn before it was answered
ending.transferred: Ended — an admin transferred this agent to another agency
ending.newContractHint: Contracting with this agent again starts a new contract; this one stays as history.

cod.hint: A slice of the agent's global COD pool — a raise can be refused if other agencies use the pool.

terms.title: Contract terms
terms.summaryFallback: Employment, fee split, remittance and limits
terms.modeStaged: This contract is live, so its terms are pricing deliveries right now. Changes here are proposed to {{name}} — the current terms keep applying until they accept. Employment details are yours alone and save immediately.
terms.modeOursToAnswer: {{name}} has put these terms forward. Accept them as they are, or change them below to send a counter-offer back.
terms.modeNeedsTerms: {{name}} applied without naming terms, so there is nothing to accept yet. Set the fee split below and send it — the contract starts when they agree.
terms.modeTheirsToAnswer: Your offer is with {{name}}. You can revise these figures while they think about it; the contract starts when they accept.
terms.proposalBlocked: You already have a change waiting on this agent — withdraw it first.
terms.proposalBlockedHint: A change is already waiting on this agent — withdraw it above first.

trail.title: Terms history
trail.summary: Every change proposed to this contract
trail.empty: No terms changes have been proposed on this contract.

settlements.title: Settlements
settlements.summary: Outstanding cash and deposits on this contract
settlements.hint: Outstanding cash must reach zero before this contract can end. Last settled {{date}}.
settlements.noDeposits: No deposits recorded under this contract.

eligibility.title: Assignment eligibility
eligibility.summary: Whether this agent can take a shipment right now

reasons.agent_not_active: the agent's account is not active
reasons.membership_not_approved: the contract is not in force

history.title: History
history.summary: Everything that has happened with this agent

reason.pauseHint: A mutual break: no new assignments, shipments already in flight are untouched. Reinstate whenever you both want to restart.
reason.terminateHint: This proposes termination — the contract ends once the agent agrees and any outstanding cash and unpaid earnings are settled.

footer.waitingOnYou: {{name}} is waiting on your answer to the terms above.
footer.waitingOnThem: Waiting on {{name}} to accept your terms. You can revise them above while they decide.
footer.needsTerms: {{name}} applied without naming terms. Send them an offer to start the contract.

_historyEventsComment: Membership-log event types. Append-only server-side, so an unrecognised token falls back to its humanized form.

fields.employmentHint: Your own record about this agent — saved on its own, without needing their agreement, and per contract: the same person can be your employee and another agency's freelancer.
fields.feeSplitHint: The agent's cut comes out of your delivery fee, never on top — the vendor pays the same either way. The platform pays it from the agent's own earnings account.
fields.remittanceHint: How often the agent hands over the cash they collect. Tightening it needs their agreement — the cadence feeds a trust penalty, so a change they never signed would start docking their score.
fields.regionsHint: Comma-separated. Where this agent works for you — it cannot exceed the area they agreed to cover. Leave empty for no restriction.
fields.ceilingHint: The most this agent may carry on one shipment. Leave empty for no cap.

errors.percentageNeedsShare: A percentage split needs an agent share.
errors.flatNeedsFee: A flat split needs a flat fee.
errors.shareOutOfRange: The agent share must be between 0 and 100.

terms._pathsComment: Keyed by the API's dotted diff path. Nested to match, because `.` is i18next's nesting separator — a flat "fee_split.model" key would never resolve.

toasts.offerSent: Offer sent — the agent can accept it, decline it, or come back with their own terms.
toasts.suspended: Agent suspended — they keep current shipments but receive no new ones.
toasts.paused: Agent paused — they keep current shipments but receive no new ones.
toasts.removalRequested: Removal requested — the contract ends once the agent agrees and cash is settled.
toasts.termsCountered: Terms sent — the agent has to accept them before the contract starts.
toasts.proposalSent: Proposal sent — your current terms stay in force until the agent answers.
toasts.proposalApproved: Terms updated — the new split applies from now on.
toasts.proposalDeclined: Proposal declined. Your current terms are unchanged.
toasts.counterProposalSent: Counter-proposal sent — the agent has to answer it.
toasts.proposalWithdrawn: Proposal withdrawn — the contract is unchanged.
toasts.requestCancelled: Request cancelled — the contract is unchanged.
